## Research interests

Computational methods for spatial transcriptomics, cell-cell communication, and subcellular gene expression.

## Current project

::: {.research-panel}
[In progress]{.panel-label}

### Bringing the endoplasmic reticulum into cell-cell interaction prediction

Many of the signals cells send to each other, such as secreted ligands, are made in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) before they leave the cell. Most methods for predicting cell-cell interactions ignore where inside a cell a gene is expressed, so they miss this ER-specific information.

My current work explores how this kind of subcellular information, starting with the ER, can be brought into spatial transcriptomics analyses to improve predictions of how cells communicate.

**Keywords:** spatial transcriptomics · subcellular localization · endoplasmic reticulum · cell-cell communication
:::
